title: Managing a Data Breach Responsibly
paragraphs: Discovering that his small company's customer database had been accessed without authorization, Fahri faced the difficult decision of how transparently to communicate this breach to customers whose trust the incident had potentially jeopardized.

A lawyer advised minimizing public disclosure to limit reputational damage, while a technology consultant argued that customers deserved complete transparency regardless of the potential short-term business consequences involved.

Fahri ultimately chose full transparency, notifying every affected customer directly with specific details about what information had been compromised and what concrete steps the company was taking in response.

While the company did lose some customers immediately following the disclosure, Fahri later noted that the transparent approach preserved considerably more long-term trust than a minimized disclosure would likely have maintained once the full truth eventually emerged.
